name: Color Me Shop
description: Color Me Shop (カラーミーショップ) API for shops in Japan: orders with tracking numbers, payment status and buyer emails, customers, products, variants and stock, categories, payment and delivery methods, reviews and sales totals. OAuth private app.
instructions:
## Color Me Shop
This connector works with the **Color Me Shop API** of GMO Pepabo (`https://api.shop-pro.jp/v1`), for shops on カラーミーショップ (Japan): orders (sales) with shipment, payment and buyer emails, customers, products, variants and stock, categories, payment and delivery methods, reviews and sales totals.

**Setup (about 10 minutes)**
1. Create a free developer account at `https://api.shop-pro.jp/developers/sign_up` and add a **private app** (アプリ名 and Redirect URI only; no review).
2. As the Redirect URI enter `https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/api/mcp-oauth/callback` on AnythingMCP Cloud (or `<your AnythingMCP URL>/api/mcp-oauth/callback` when you host AnythingMCP yourself).
3. Copy the app's **Client ID** into `COLORME_CLIENT_ID` and **Client Secret** into `COLORME_CLIENT_SECRET`, and install the connector.
4. Click **Authorize with Provider** on the connector page and log in with your Color Me Shop admin account. The connector asks for `read_products write_products read_sales write_sales`.

The access token does not expire and has no refresh token; the shop owner can revoke it in the shop admin (installed apps). Then authorize again.

**Where to start**: `color_me_shop_list_sales` with delivered false (orders still to ship; the default period is the last 7 days, widen it with after), then `color_me_shop_get_sale` for the buyer, the items and the delivery ids.

**Orders**: `color_me_shop_list_sales`, `color_me_shop_get_sale`, `color_me_shop_get_sales_stat`. Shipping: `color_me_shop_update_sale_delivery` sets the slip (tracking) number and delivered on one delivery of the order (sale_deliveries[].id), then `color_me_shop_send_sale_mail` with type delivered emails the buyer. `color_me_shop_set_sale_paid` records a received payment; `color_me_shop_send_sale_mail` also sends the accepted and paid mails. `color_me_shop_cancel_sale` is installed switched off: it cannot be undone.

**Customers**: `color_me_shop_list_customers` and `color_me_shop_get_customer` (personal data; scope read_sales).

**Products and stock**: `color_me_shop_list_products`, `color_me_shop_get_product`, `color_me_shop_list_product_variants`, `color_me_shop_list_stocks` (low or recent zero stock), `color_me_shop_update_product` (name, prices, cost, model number, short description, stock of a product without options), `color_me_shop_update_variant` (stock and option price of one variant). `color_me_shop_set_product_display` is switched off, because hidden takes a product off the shop. `color_me_shop_list_categories`, `color_me_shop_list_payments`, `color_me_shop_list_deliveries`, `color_me_shop_list_reviews` and `color_me_shop_get_shop` give the reference data. Creating products and orders, images and coupons are not included.

**Formats**: prices in yen; dates in filters are `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss`; times in answers are Unix seconds. Lists take `limit` (orders and customers up to 100, products and stock up to 50) and `offset`, with `meta.total`. Errors are `errors` with `code`, `message` and `status`: 401010 invalid token or missing scope, 401011 revoked token, 403000 a sub-admin without the right, 404100 not found, 422 invalid input.

**Rate limit**: about 120 requests per minute per token; above that 429 (code 429000). GMO Pepabo also runs an official Color Me Shop MCP server for the AI connector app; this connector talks to the REST API directly.

COLORME_CLIENT_ID.label: Client ID
COLORME_CLIENT_ID.help: Color Me Shop developer site, your private app: Client ID.
COLORME_CLIENT_ID.patternMessage: Paste the Client ID only, without spaces.

COLORME_CLIENT_SECRET.label: Client Secret
COLORME_CLIENT_SECRET.help: Color Me Shop developer site, your private app: Client Secret.
COLORME_CLIENT_SECRET.patternMessage: Paste the Client Secret without spaces.

verifyHints.401: Color Me Shop refused the token (401010 invalid or missing scope, 401011 revoked). Click Authorize with Provider again.
verifyHints.403: The logged-in admin lacks the right for this feature (403000), or the token lacks a scope. Authorize again with the shop owner account.
verifyHints.404: Color Me Shop found no order, customer or product with that id (404100).
verifyHints.rate_limited: Color Me Shop allows about 120 requests per minute per token. Wait a moment and try again.

prerequisites: A Color Me Shop (カラーミーショップ) shop and a free developer account at api.shop-pro.jp to create a private app. About 10 minutes.

tools.name: color_me_shop_get_shop
tools.description: The shop behind the token: id, state, contract plan, url, open state, login id, title, owner email and tax settings. Read-only.

tools.name: color_me_shop_list_sales
tools.description: List orders (sales), newest first: id, make_date, update_date, payment_id, paid, delivered, canceled, accepted, paid and delivered mail states, product_total_price, delivery_total_charge, fee, tax, total_price, customer, details (product, option, price, quantity) and sale_deliveries (id, delivery method, address, slip_number, delivered), with `meta` (total, limit, offset). Without dates the last 7 days. Read-only.

after.description: Ordered on or after (default: 7 days ago): YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, Japan time.

before.description: Ordered on or before: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, Japan time.

update_date_min.description: Updated on or after: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, Japan time.

update_date_max.description: Updated on or before: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, Japan time.

accepted_mail_state.description: Order confirmation mail: not_yet (not sent), sent or pass (not to be sent).

paid_mail_state.description: Payment confirmation mail: not_yet (not sent), sent or pass (not to be sent).

delivered_mail_state.description: Shipping mail: not_yet (not sent), sent or pass (not to be sent).

tools.name: color_me_shop_get_sale
tools.description: Read one order: dates, payment method, paid, delivered, canceled, mail states, point state, totals, customer (name, furigana, email, address, phone), details (product, options, price, quantity) and sale_deliveries (id, delivery method, recipient, preferred date and period, slip_number, delivered). Read-only.

tools.name: color_me_shop_get_sales_stat
tools.description: Sales totals for fixed periods around a day: amount and count for that day, the last 7 days and that month. Read-only.

tools.name: color_me_shop_list_customers
tools.description: List customers: id, name, furigana, mail, postal, address, tel, member, points, membership and mail magazine consent, with `meta`. Filter by name, email, phone, postal code or dates. Read-only.

make_date_min.description: Registered on or after: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, Japan time.

make_date_max.description: Registered on or before: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, Japan time.

tools.name: color_me_shop_get_customer
tools.description: Read one customer: name, furigana, email, address, phones, member, points, membership and order count. Read-only.

tools.name: color_me_shop_list_products
tools.description: List products, newest first: id, name, model_number, price (list price), sales_price, members_price, cost, display_state, stock_managed, stocks, categories, groups, variants and images, with `meta` (total, limit, offset). Up to 50 per page. Read-only.

stocks.description: Only stock-managed products with at most this many in stock (per option where options carry the stock).

recent_zero_stocks.description: true: only products that dropped to 0 stock in the last week.

update_date_min.description: Updated on or after: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, Japan time.

update_date_max.description: Updated on or before: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, Japan time.

sort.description: Sort columns, comma-separated, `-` for descending, e.g. `-update_date` (default `-make_date`).

tools.name: color_me_shop_get_product
tools.description: Read one product: name, prices, cost, model number, descriptions, display_state, stock settings and stocks, categories, groups, options, variants (with their stock) and images. Read-only.

tools.name: color_me_shop_list_product_variants
tools.description: Variants (option combinations) of one product: id, option1_value, option2_value, title, stocks, few_num (low-stock warning level), model_number and option prices. Up to 50 per page. Read-only.

tools.name: color_me_shop_list_stocks
tools.description: Stock per product and option: product_id, name, model number, option1_value, option2_value and stocks. Filter by low stock or recent zero stock. Up to 50 per page. Read-only.

stocks.description: Only stock-managed products with at most this many in stock (per option where options carry the stock).

recent_zero_stocks.description: true: only products that dropped to 0 stock in the last week.

tools.name: color_me_shop_list_categories
tools.description: Product categories: id_big, id_small, name, display_state and children. Read-only.

tools.name: color_me_shop_list_payments
tools.description: Payment methods of the shop: id, name, type and fees. Read-only.

tools.name: color_me_shop_list_deliveries
tools.description: Delivery methods of the shop: id, name, method type, charges and settings (delivery_id of an order delivery). Read-only.

tools.name: color_me_shop_list_reviews
tools.description: Product reviews: product, rating, title, body, reviewer and dates, with `meta`. Read-only.

tools.name: color_me_shop_update_sale_delivery
tools.description: Record the shipment of one delivery of an order: the tracking (slip) number and whether it is delivered (shipped). Send the shipping mail afterwards with color_me_shop_send_sale_mail.

delivery_id.description: Id of the order delivery (sale_deliveries[].id of color_me_shop_get_sale), not the delivery method.

tools.name: color_me_shop_set_sale_paid
tools.description: Mark an order as paid (payment received, e.g. a bank transfer arrived) or back to unpaid.

tools.name: color_me_shop_send_sale_mail
tools.description: Send the buyer the order confirmation (accepted), payment confirmation (paid) or shipping (delivered) email of an order, with the shop template. Answers 201 with no body.

tools.name: color_me_shop_update_product
tools.description: Change the name, list price, selling price, members price, cost, model number, short description or stock of one product (stock only for a product without option stock; use color_me_shop_update_variant for those). Fields left out keep their value.

tools.name: color_me_shop_update_variant
tools.description: Change the stock, low-stock warning level, model number or option price of one variant.

option_price.description: Selling price of the variant in yen.

tools.name: color_me_shop_set_product_display
tools.description: Change where a product is shown: showing, hidden, showing_for_members or sale_for_members. hidden takes it off the shop.

tools.name: color_me_shop_cancel_sale
tools.description: Cancel an order, optionally putting the stock back. Cannot be undone. Split orders and card payments linked to Epsilon cannot be cancelled here.

restock.description: true: return the items to stock.
